title: Handoff Brief
description: What a Copilot Studio agent hands to a human representative so the customer never has to repeat themselves. Serialized into ONE context variable (zrh_HandoffBrief). Dynamics 365 caps a context variable value at 4,000 characters and the whole transfer payload at 28 KB, so keep it compact.

reason.description: Why the customer contacted us, in one line.

goal.description: What the customer wants to end up with.

summary.description: Two or three sentences on the conversation so far.

escalation.description: Why the AI agent handed off.

facts.description: Everything the customer already told the AI agent. The representative must not ask for these again.

v.description: Value as the customer gave it (mask secrets).

ask.description: Optional phrases a representative would use to ask for this fact; used by the re-ask detector. Defaults are derived from the label.

verified.description: Identity verification done by the AI agent.

tried.description: Steps the AI agent already took, and what happened.

next.description: Suggested next step for the representative.

opener.description: Suggested first message that proves we listened.
